text:
Anna: Ok team, starting the DB cutover watch at 22:00 UTC. small, tracked rollout — please stand by in case we need to abort. :eyes:
Kevin: On standby. what are our quick abort criteria?
Anna: Abort if (1) write latency > 300ms for 3 consecutive 30s buckets, (2) any 5xx spike > 0.5% sustained for 2 min, or (3) >0.2% row-lock queue growth for 5m.
Maya: Noted. telemetry dashboards linked: https://internal.redwood/ops/cutover-telemetry (refresh every 10s).
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy started at 22:00:30 UTC. Job id: deploy-1739512460. Rolling 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 10m windows.
Sam: Preflight checks: replica lag < 2s, schema-migrations applied to canaries, bg job worker pool healthy. all green from my side. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: Disk usage on pg-primary: 62%. maintenance buffer ok. KV cache primed for new schema keys.
Kevin: Backfill plan reminder — batch size 500, throttle to 200 qps, early exit if error rate > 0.1%. Backfill job name: bf_user_profiles_2026_03.
Anna: If backfill stalls, run: `SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%bf_user_profiles_2026_03%' LIMIT 1;` then escalate. Do NOT run mass delete.
Maya: Who's pager if the abort triggers? OpsPager on first page, then Sam -> Kevin. Ops runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/db-cutover-fallback
OpsPager: I have the rotation. If abort happens I will post a short rollback plan and open the incident channel.
deploy-bot: At 22:05:30, rollout at 25%. No errors.
Sam: Seeing a small spike in locks on shard 7, but queue depth stable. holding.
Kevin: watching latency — 210ms steady. still within threshold.
Anna: Proceed to full rollout at 22:10 if no regression. keep backfill paused until 22:12 to observe steady state.
deploy-bot: 22:10:00 rollout -> 100% complete. No deploy errors reported.
Maya: Telemetry shows a transient 400ms at 22:11:15 but 2 samples only. below abort threshold.
Sam: Starting backfill now (22:12). throttle set to 180 qps.
deploy-bot: backfill job bf_user_profiles_2026_03 started. job id bf-1739512460.
Kevin: If backfill error > 0.1% we will pause and revert feature flag (ff.profile-read). Revert command: `POST /api/flags/ff.profile-read?state=off` (ops token).
Anna: Update: at 22:18 we hit 0.12% backfill errors due to timeouts on shard 7. Pausing backfill.
Sam: Paused backfill. investigating underlying DB timeouts. rolling restart of worker pool for retries.
Maya: Good call — feature flag remains enabled but traffic is normal. if timeout recurs after retries, we will toggle flag and resume a smaller batch.
OpsPager: If we need to roll back the schema migration, plan is rollback migration 20260322_add_profile_idx (script in runbook) and promote previous binary. This is slow — incident will be escalated.
deploy-bot: backfill job paused by operator at 22:20:40.
Anna: After 2 retries the timeouts cleared, errors dropped to 0.03%. Sam, confirm we can resume at 120 qps.
Sam: Resuming at 120 qps. monitoring closely.
Kevin: All metrics trending normal for 6 minutes. no further action.
Maya: Great. I'll prepare a short release note for the channel and update the ops doc with timing + observations.
Anna: Thanks all — moving to post-cutover validations. will close this thread when release note posted. :tada:
Maya: Release note posted: "2026-03-15 DB cutover: migration applied, backfill completed with brief pause on shard 7, no rollback required." link: https://internal.redwood/notes/1739512460-cutover
Anna: Closing watchparty. If anything pops up, reopen thread or page OpsPager. Good job team. :rocket:
